nodes.title: Typography review lab scope
nodes.detail: Bound by tools/design_type_review_graph.py from the operator's explicit file key and page ID.

nodes.title: Designer · legible type system
nodes.detail: A reusable typography component presents display, label and body styles with measured range metadata.

nodes.title: Developer · inspectable API evidence
nodes.detail: The component records exact official member keys, rank, receiver and verified values for its styling operations.

nodes.title: Reusable typography specimen component
nodes.detail: Created only from a newly created frame. An identical graph selection reuses it; a later version or epoch creates a sibling and preserves previous components.

nodes.title: Typography setters verified by native getters
nodes.detail: Read back font name, size, line height, letter spacing, fill, CSS summary, radius, effects, dash pattern, strokes and fills.
